description: Get the on-chain contract-safety findings (GoPlus) for a token: honeypot, mintable, ownership renounced, hidden owner, transfer-pausable, holder concentration. Use it when the question is specifically about the token's contract; use check_token_risk for an overall risk picture. Findings can be stale (the result says when a fresh check is needed), and a symbol shared by several tokens resolves to one of them. Absence of a flag is not a guarantee of safety.
name: check_contract_safety
